title: A treadmill speed above the top is shown but not saved
what: Typing a speed above 40 (or a level above 100, or a second decimal point) leaves the number in the box, but the set's stored value is quietly cleared, so History shows no speed and the member is never told.
expected: The box says the number is too high (or refuses it), so what is on screen is what is saved.
who: members logging treadmill or bike sets
how_often: when a number above the machine's top is typed
fix_line: Show a short message under the box, or keep the box at the last saved value
